state_before_final_user_gate: V1.0 is a Freeze Candidate only. This JSON declares the proposed scope; it does not freeze anything.
proposed_frozen_normative_scope: Local-first modular monolith with ports/adapters and domain/infrastructure separation.
Interaction, Application, Orchestrator, Core Domain/Capabilities, Ports, Adapters and Infrastructure responsibility boundaries; Orchestrator does not own core data.
The 11 existing core-domain objects plus Link remain the semantic core; V1.0 does not create a second core model.
Model and Agent are distinct; Model has no execution authority and Agent authorization follows a bounded task.
TypeScript Core direction, Tauri 2 desktop direction and React/TypeScript UI direction.
SQLite as V1 local authority, FTS-first search, and rebuildable/deletable derivatives.
External capability is accessed through Ports/Adapters; core must not become vendor-bound.
Authorization is required on important consumption and execution paths, with all retained V0.1 recheck/fail-closed constraints from reconciliation.
P3-129 reconciliation's retained V0.1 safety invariants and forward-only V0.1 supersession semantics.
explicitly_not_frozen: IPC command signatures and Tauri capability configuration
FTS table structure, PRAGMA, worker implementation and scheduling
Vector DB, Redis, Temporal, Fastify, PostgreSQL, cloud/sync protocol, smart-home or AR stack
production SLA, capacity commitment, export format, backup/recovery implementation or deletion/cleanup SLA
P3-126/P3-127 Runtime candidate, product IA, real capability enablement, risk closure, engineering baseline restoration or Stage 4

scope_guards.guard: No Schema/API/IPC/capability signature is Frozen by this task.
No actual Tauri packaging, filesystem/Vault/export capability, network/cloud/model or product Runtime is validated or enabled.
No core-domain, V1-scope or AI-trust semantic change is made; existing frozen baselines are inherited.
V0.1 forward authority moves only after final Gate. Its history, Evidence and retained safety constraints remain.
No risk is closed/reopened and Stage 4 is not entered.

negative_scope_cases.attempt: Add SQLite Schema to frozen scope
Add an IPC signature or Tauri capability to frozen scope
Declare P3-126 Runtime or real capability Frozen
Treat architectural freeze as Stage 4 or risk-closure authorization
